final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS baseline_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS mean_group_average, AVG(group_avg - baseline_avg) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM group_avgs CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE group_avg > baseline_avg
